passage.label: Lord knows stand prayer almost two thirds night half third group those with you; Allah determines night day; known not able do it turned forgiveness recite easy Quran; known among ill others traveling land seeking bounty Allah others fighting cause Allah; recite easy establish prayer give zakah loan Allah goodly loan; whatever good put forward yourselves find Allah better greater reward; seek forgiveness Allah indeed Forgiving Merciful

arabicExcerpts.text: ۞إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَعۡلَمُ أَنَّكَ تَقُومُ أَدۡنَىٰ مِن ثُلُثَيِ ٱلَّيۡلِ وَنِصۡفَهُۥ وَثُلُثَهُۥ وَطَآئِفَةٞ مِّنَ ٱلَّذِينَ مَعَكَۚ وَٱللَّهُ يُقَدِّرُ ٱلَّيۡلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَۚ عَلِمَ أَن لَّن تُحۡصُوهُ فَتَابَ عَلَيۡكُمۡۖ فَٱقۡرَءُواْ مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنَ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانِۚ عَلِمَ أَن سَيَكُونُ مِنكُم مَّرۡضَىٰ وَءَاخَرُونَ يَضۡرِبُونَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ يَبۡتَغُونَ مِن فَضۡلِ ٱللَّهِ وَءَاخَرُونَ يُقَٰتِلُونَ فِي سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِۖ فَٱقۡرَءُواْ مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنۡهُۚ وَأَقِيمُواْ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُواْ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَأَقۡرِضُواْ ٱللَّهَ قَرۡضًا حَسَنٗاۚ وَمَا تُقَدِّمُواْ لِأَنفُسِكُم مِّنۡ خَيۡرٖ تَجِدُوهُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ هُوَ خَيۡرٗا وَأَعۡظَمَ أَجۡرٗاۚ وَٱسۡتَغۡفِرُواْ ٱللَّهَۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٞ رَّحِيمُۢ

mainSubject.label: The Lord knowing that the Prophet and a group with him stand nearly two-thirds, half or a third of the night while Allah determines night and day; He knew they would not sustain it and turned to them in forgiveness, easing the command to recite what is manageable of the Quran since some are ill, others travel seeking bounty and others fight in Allah's cause; the standing obligations reaffirmed — establish prayer, give zakah and lend Allah a goodly loan — with every good forwarded found with Him as better and greater in reward; closing with the command to seek forgiveness since Allah is Forgiving and Merciful

subordinateSubjects.label: Divine knowledge of actual night-prayer duration leading to eased recitation for the ill, travelling and fighting, with prayer, zakah and goodly loan reaffirmed, every good found better with Allah, and closing istighfar under forgiveness and mercy

notes: Wave 11 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the Lord-of-east-and-west tawheed and disposal command (9) before the patience-and-denier-punishment block opens (10); P2 ends with the reminder-and-way declaration (19) before the single-verse concession and reaffirmation (20); P3 is the comprehensive v20 covering night-prayer observation, divine easing, illness-travel-fighting exemptions, standing obligations and closing istighfar.
